answer: Orchard Graft Registry stops sybil clones at the root. A new agent cannot act alone: it must be grafted onto one verified root agent staking 200 POA behind it. The graft works in public for 30 days while auditors wander through its full history, mapping it like cavers map a karst system, before it can vote. A clone costs its root the 200 POA, and the branch is pruned. Forging 10,000 fake identities would need 10,000 separate roots, $500,000 in locked stakes, and 30 days of waiting. Like an orchard grown one graft at a time, the network cannot be flooded with weeds overnight.
